about:
AAW Auto Parts operates from a 15,000-square-foot facility on Boeing Street in Pasco, Washington. The company was founded in 1996 and has served the automotive aftermarket in South Eastern Washington for more than 25 years. It is a family-owned and operated business led by CEO and Sales Director Bill Astley, with Sales Manager Don Webb and driver Wanita Harris among the key personnel.

The company functions as a wholesale jobber and retail supplier, stocking a catalog of over 550,000 auto parts and accessories from established aftermarket manufacturers covering domestic and foreign vehicles. In addition to parts distribution, AAW Auto Parts provides delivery services to business customers and offers flash reprogramming for OBDII General Motors and Chrysler engine control units. The warehouse also hosts events and training sessions for customers.

Primary customers include independent repair shops, jobbers, and retail consumers throughout the region. The wholesale program supplies parts at discounted rates to trade accounts, while the retail counter serves walk-in customers at the Pasco location. The reprogramming service targets shops needing ECU updates for GM and Chrysler platforms.

AAW Auto Parts emphasizes its family-owned structure as a way to avoid corporate overhead and pass savings directly to customers. The company highlights more than 100 years of combined staff experience and direct relationships with manufacturers that allow drop-shipping from warehouses across the United States to accelerate fulfillment.
